subject: Inference demo timing — compliance window blocks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@glacia.com>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@glacia.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Inference demo timing — quick sync on availability

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the time on last week's intro call. The team asked for a short technical demo to show how Redwood Inference handles model routing and latency controls for regulated workloads. I pulled a few slots next week (30–45 minutes):

- Tue 5/4, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 5/5, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 5/6, 09:00–09:45 PT

If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and a one-page mutual action plan to make the session productive. If there are constraints (security folks want to join, or you'd prefer a pre-recorded walkthrough), tell me and we’ll adapt.

I can also share a short SOC 2 excerpt and the MAP in advance.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Glacia_v1.xlsx (stub)
From: Lena Park <lena.park@glacia.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@glacia.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inference demo timing — quick sync on availability

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the follow-up and the proposed slots. Unfortunately, we’re entering a company-wide compliance audit window next week (internal SOC review + vendor attestations), and our security and procurement teams are being pulled into meetings across the org. On top of that, I’ll be traveling for a customer-facing trip 5/4–5/8, so I won’t be available to take a demo or loop in the right stakeholders until after the audit is closed.

Given the timing I need to pause scheduling for now — can we put Glacia on a short hold and plan to revisit in August? If you have SOC2 excerpts and a short recording, please send them over and I’ll circulate to security for asynchronous review, but we are deprioritizing new vendor evaluations until the audit is complete.

Thanks for understanding,
Lena
Director, Platform Ops
Glacia Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@glacia.com>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@glacia.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-05T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inference demo timing — quick sync on availability

Hi Lena —

Totally understood, and thanks for the heads-up. We’ll mark this opportunity as on-hold until you give the green light. In the meantime I attached a short SOC2 excerpt and the MAP so security can do an initial pass without a live demo. If it helps, we can also record a 12-minute walkthrough of the platform (no execs required) and share that for your team to review on their own time.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- I’ll log the hold reason and expected revisit month in HubSpot (Aug).
- Share SOC2_excerpt.pdf and MAP_Glacia_v1.xlsx now.
- Offer an async demo recording if security asks for an operational walkthrough.

If your audit schedule slips or you have a small working session that’d like Redwood on for a short Q&A, ping me and I’ll try to accommodate. Otherwise we’ll check back the first week of August to re-open scheduling.

Best,
Vivek
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_excerpt.pdf (stub), MAP_Glacia_v1.xlsx (stub)

Date: 2027-05-06T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Inference demo timing — compliance window blocks (internal)

Vivek —

Thanks for the update and for sending the SOC2 excerpt. I’ve added a note to the HubSpot record (deal GLAC-2027-084) marking the stage as "on hold — compliance audit" with an expected revisit in 2027-08. I uploaded the MAP to our shared Drive link and flagged a reminder for Aug 02 to reach out.

If you want, I’ll prepare a one-slide internal summary we can drop into an August follow-up that calls out: risk profile, latency SLOs, and the ask for a 30-minute technical recon. Also recommend we queue an async demo video now so procurement/security can triage while they’re heads-down.

Let me know and I’ll own the follow-up prep.

—Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
